text:
samir: Quick thread  AstraScale case/launch needs a final pass. They liked the narrative but want one line of the quote tightened and an embargo date confirmed. Can legal review by EOD Tue?
claire: Paste the exact quote they want us to publish. Legal needs verbatim text.
samir: AstraScale VP Eng suggested: `Redwood cut our p95 latency by ~63% and reduced inference cost by almost 48%, which let us ship features faster.`
mike: Design/asset ask: need svg logo, 2 headshots, and one product screenshot. Also want a short hero title that isnt customer-named pre-approval. Suggest: "Faster inference, lower cost at scale".
june: Ops routing  set hidden field `campaign=astrascale_launch` and route inbound webinar leads to NA_AE, tag @june for follow-up. Also map SF campaign ASTRA-2026-LAUNCH.
legal-bot: Redline recommendations: change '~63%' -> 'approximately 63%'; change 'almost 48%' -> 'approximately 48%'; prefer 'reduced inference cost by approximately 48%' for tone. Require an email release: \"AstraScale grants Redwood permission to publish the quote, logo, and a 10s video clip on or after the agreed publish date.\" Need permission for translated versions if we localize.
priya: Webinar timing: two slots open  Jul 20 10:00 PT or Jul 22 09:00 PT. Product prefers Jul 22 to complete final test. Target publish date Jul 29 (one week after webinar) under embargo.
claire: I'll update the draft with legal's wording and paste the new verbatim quote here for approval. Also will keep the hero slide generic until logo permissions land.
claire: Updated quote (verbatim we will seek approval for):
```
"Redwood reduced our p95 latency by approximately 63% and reduced inference costs by approximately 48%, which allowed us to ship features faster." 1 AstraScale VP Eng
```
legal-bot: That follows our style guide. Also request explicit logo usage terms (svg ok) and confirmation that no customer revenue numbers will be used. An anonymized ARR band is ok if the customer approves.
june: I'll set the lead form hidden field and create the routing rule. Also prepare nurture: teaser -> reminder -> replay with CTA=book-demo.
mike: I'll build a neutral hero slide: "Faster inference, lower cost at scale" and a social pack. Will swap in AstraScale assets post-approval. Also will capture a 10s soundbite during the webinar.
samir: I emailed AstraScale comms asking for: 1) exact publish date (we suggested Jul 29), 2) the email release with quote + logo permission, and 3) svg + headshots. Asked them to confirm translation permission for FR/DE.
ops-bot: SF mapping set  campaign=ASTRA-2026-LAUNCH; lead owner rule=NA_AE then round-robin.
claire: Once the customer's email arrives with the publish date and release text, paste it here and legal will add final sign-off.
legal-bot: If the approval email arrives by Tue EOD, legal can clear for Jul 29 publish and allow webinar Jul 22 recording embed on landing.
calendar-bot: Tentative event created  "AstraScale launch webinar prep" Jul 22 09:00 PT  invites: samir,claire,mike,june,priya
priya: Ops note  we'll add hidden field + utm params: `utm_source=astrascale`, `utm_campaign=ASTRA-2026-LAUNCH`. Nurture start date set to Jul 20 pending legal greenlight.
june: Checklist: 1) Customer email release with publish date & logo terms (samir) 2) Legal sign-off (legal-bot) 3) Assets in shared folder (svg/headshots/screens) (astra comms) 4) Slide + onepager + social pack (mike) 5) Webinar landing + routing to NA_AE (priya) 6) Recording & 10s soundbite (mike) 7) SF campaign mapping (june)  target publish Jul 29.
samir: Thanks all  will update thread once AstraScale replies. :thumbsup:
